Application Data.NAME: BrightVac Sales & Service, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: BrightVac Sales & Service, LLC specializes in the retail and servicing of vacuum cleaners, offering both sales and repair services to residential and commercial clients. Our operations include in-store shopping experiences, online sales through a secure e-commerce platform, and on-site repair services conducted by trained technicians. We maintain a dedicated service area, ensuring a safe environment for both customers and staff while performing repairs. Our business adheres to established safety protocols and product quality controls to minimize risks associated with electrical malfunctions and product misuse. We also prioritize customer satisfaction and product reliability through comprehensive warranty policies and ongoing training for our employees to uphold quality service standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a customer reported a vacuum cleaner purchased from our store malfunctioning and overheating, which led to minor property damage (burn marks) in their home. The claim amounted to $2,000. The case was settled in May 2023, with a reimbursement issued to the customer. Current status: Closed.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and alarm systems are installed throughout the premises to ensure safety and monitor activity during business hours, along with a security guard on-site during peak operational hours.
